Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
options: among
of
besides
up
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "of"

Explanation:
☛ The correct phrase here is "glimpse of history" because "of" denotes a relationship between two nouns.
☛ In "Looking at the stars is a glimpse of history", "of" shows that stars offer a glimpse into history.
☛ "Among" (in the middle of), "besides" (in addition to), and "up" (direction) are irrelevant here.
☛ The preposition "of" indicates possession/relation, as in "a cup of tea" or "the sound of music".
